literal_meaning: গলায় কাপড় বা বস্ত্র পরা (cloth around the neck)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গলবস্ত্র হয়ে আমি আপনাকে অনুরোধ করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: With extreme humility, I request you.
He begged for forgiveness with folded hands.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali customs where wrapping a cloth around the neck symbolized submission or deep respect in rural or semi-rural settings.
note: The expression evokes a visual of subservience, common in older Bengali literature and oral traditions.
